entities.title: qwen-chat
entities.summary: A command-line chat with the Qwen3.5-9B language model, run locally by llama.cpp compiled into the binary.
entities.purpose: The crate of the qwen-chat binary: Cargo.toml, the user README, and the sources in src/. It is one member of the Cargo workspace in macos/rust and builds one binary.
boundaries: It stands alone: it uses no other tool in the repository, and nothing in the repository calls it.
The model weights are not in the repository or the binary; the binary downloads them once into a cache folder.
CI builds and tests it on macOS and Linux; the release workflow does not ship it yet (see src/.dev/backlog.json).
